types.description: S202M-C4 miniature circuit breaker; two poles; C characteristic; 4 A; Icn 10 kA at 400 V AC (IEC/EN 60898-1)

document.title: Electrical installation solutions for buildings — MCBs

modelingNotes: Exact selection: S202M-C4, two poles, C characteristic, rated current 4 A. IEC/EN 60898-1: 400 V AC, 50/60 Hz, Icn 10 kA; C characteristic reference temperature 30 degrees C. Voltage is capability, not assigned supply. Other standard-dependent ratings are not flattened into this model.

Connection evidence: ABB System pro M compact, 2CSC400002D0211 (2014 file edition), printed 2/38 (PDF 64) exact selection and 11/2 (PDF 1068) visually reviewed S202 family wiring diagram: https://new.abb.com/docs/librariesprovider74/lp-materials/prom-2014-2csc400002d0211.pdf?sfvrsn=2

Numbered nodes 1-2 and 3-4 are switched breaker poles, mechanically ganged. Open is the drawing state, not a prediction of installed operating state. No fixed electrical links or phase/neutral assignments.

Each numbered shared terminal includes its cable/busbar twin entry. IEC terminal capacities: solid/stranded conductor 35 mm², flexible 25 mm², busbar 10 mm²; torque 2.8 N·m. These notes do not validate conductor selection or arbitrary wire multiplicity.

Base order only; separately fitted auxiliary contacts, signal contacts, releases and motor mechanisms are separate devices. No universally required external connection is asserted for these passive switching points.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four numbered base-breaker electrical nodes are represented, including shared cable/busbar terminal entries. No base PE, shield, communication or auxiliary terminals; separately fitted accessories are outside this exact order.
